title: limonium gilesii
intro: Limonium gilesii, commonly known as Giles' Sea Lavender, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. It is traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, providing relief from anxiety, stress, and insomnia due to its sedative and calming effects. The health benefits of Limonium gilesii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, anxiety, and other mood disorders. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
